entities.summary: Husum is a town in and the administrative capital of the North Frisia district (Nordfriesland) of the German state of Schleswig-Holstein. The town was the birthplace of the novelist Theodor Storm, who coined the epithet "the grey town by the sea". It is also the home of the annual international piano festival Raritäten der Klaviermusik founded in 1987.
